en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning remain in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said northerly winds continued, with extreme fire risk and temperatures recovering after a 17.5-degree low.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal, issued at 6.10am on Monday, remained in force on Tuesday. Strong northerly winds with mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour were expected, and gusts would occasionally reach gale force.

The Red Fire Danger Warning, also issued at 6.10am on Monday, continued in force. The Observatory said the fire risk was extreme and reminded the public to be extra alert and ensure necessary fire precautions were taken.

The Observatory recorded a minimum temperature of 17.5 degrees at its headquarters from midnight to early Tuesday morning. By around noon temperatures had risen to about 21 degrees under sunny and very dry conditions, with relative humidity around 40 per cent.

The Observatory advised people not well sheltered from the north to take precautions against strong gusty winds, and those planning water sports or operations at sea to take special care. Conditions remained particularly rough over offshore waters.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告持續生效
zh.dek: 天文台表示偏北強風持續，火災危險極高，清晨最低十七點五度後氣溫回升。
body: 香港天文台表示，周一清晨六時十分發出的強烈季候風信號周二仍然生效。預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
同樣在周一清晨六時十分發出的紅色火災危險警告亦繼續生效。天文台指火災危險性極高，提醒市民提高警覺，確保採取必要防火措施。
天文台總部由午夜至周二清晨錄得最低氣溫十七點五度，是入秋以來最低。至中午左右，氣溫回升至約二十一度，天氣晴朗及非常乾燥，相對濕度約百分之四十。
天文台呼籲身處當風地方的人士採取預防措施，以防強勁陣風；打算參加水上活動或進行海上工作的人士亦應特別小心，離岸海域風浪尤其大。
